flags.label: Unusual shift toward Democrats relative to state peers
flags.description: Provisional review: this county’s Democratic two-party-share change from 2022 is at least 10 percentage points in absolute size and differs unusually from eligible same-state peers. Swapping Democratic and Republican votes produces the same screen result in the opposite direction. Candidate changes, voting patterns and reporting progress may explain the difference; this is not a fraud or error finding.

flags.label: Unusual shift toward Democrats relative to state peers
flags.description: Provisional review: this county’s Democratic two-party-share change from 2022 is at least 10 percentage points in absolute size and differs unusually from eligible same-state peers. Swapping Democratic and Republican votes produces the same screen result in the opposite direction. Candidate changes, voting patterns and reporting progress may explain the difference; this is not a fraud or error finding.

flags.label: Unusual shift toward Democrats relative to state peers
flags.description: Provisional review: this county’s Democratic two-party-share change from 2022 is at least 10 percentage points in absolute size and differs unusually from eligible same-state peers. Swapping Democratic and Republican votes produces the same screen result in the opposite direction. Candidate changes, voting patterns and reporting progress may explain the difference; this is not a fraud or error finding.

flags.label: Unusual shift toward Democrats relative to state peers
flags.description: Provisional review: this county’s Democratic two-party-share change from 2022 is at least 10 percentage points in absolute size and differs unusually from eligible same-state peers. Swapping Democratic and Republican votes produces the same screen result in the opposite direction. Candidate changes, voting patterns and reporting progress may explain the difference; this is not a fraud or error finding.

flags.label: Unusual shift toward Democrats relative to state peers
flags.description: Provisional review: this county’s Democratic two-party-share change from 2022 is at least 10 percentage points in absolute size and differs unusually from eligible same-state peers. Swapping Democratic and Republican votes produces the same screen result in the opposite direction. Candidate changes, voting patterns and reporting progress may explain the difference; this is not a fraud or error finding.
